proof:
Source: steps 2 (Borel representative and the sign function g₀) and 4 (passage to the limit by dominated convergence) of the parent proof, for an arbitrary h integrable on B_{R+δ}(0); the smooth approximation of steps 2–3 is the sibling smooth_ae_approx.
Notation: B := B_{R+δ}(0); μ_B := Lebesgue measure restricted to B.
1. (Borel representative.) h is integrable on B, hence μ_B-a.e.-strongly measurable; choose a strongly measurable (hence Borel measurable) h̃ with h = h̃ μ_B-a.e. (AEStronglyMeasurable.mk and ae_eq_mk).
2. (Sign function.) Let σ(x) := 1 if h̃(x) ≥ 0 and σ(x) := −1 otherwise, and g₀ := 1_{B_R(0)}·σ. Then g₀ is measurable ({h̃ ≥ 0} is measurable and B_R(0) is open), |g₀| ≤ 1, g₀(x) = 0 whenever ‖x‖ ≥ R (such x lies outside B_R(0)), and h̃(x)σ(x) = |h̃(x)| for every x.
3. (Smooth approximants.) smooth_ae_approx applied to n, R, δ > 0 and g₀ yields smooth compactly supported G_j with tsupport G_j ⊆ B, |G_j| ≤ 1 and G_j → g₀ Lebesgue-a.e. Each G_j is an admissible test function in the hypothesis.
4. (Each pairing is at most C.) G_j(x) = 0 for x ∉ B (such x is not in tsupport G_j), so ∫_B hG_j = ∫_{ℝⁿ} hG_j (setIntegral_eq_integral_of_forall_compl_eq_zero), which is ≤ C by the hypothesis with g := G_j.
5. (Dominated convergence on B.) The functions hG_j are μ_B-a.e.-strongly measurable (h is, and G_j is continuous); |hG_j| ≤ |h|, which is μ_B-integrable; and hG_j → hg₀ μ_B-a.e., because Lebesgue-a.e. convergence implies μ_B-a.e. convergence (ae_restrict_of_ae). Hence ∫_B hG_j → ∫_B hg₀ (tendsto_integral_of_dominated_convergence).
6. (Identification of the limit.) μ_B-a.e. we have h = h̃, hence h·g₀ = 1_{B_R(0)}·h̃σ = 1_{B_R(0)}·|h̃| = 1_{B_R(0)}·|h|. Therefore ∫_B hg₀ = ∫_B 1_{B_R(0)}|h| = ∫_{B ∩ B_R(0)} |h| (setIntegral_indicator) = ∫_{B_R(0)} |h|, since B_R(0) ⊆ B (δ > 0).
7. (Conclusion.) The real sequence ∫_B hG_j is bounded above by C (step 4) and converges to ∫_{B_R(0)} |h| (steps 5–6), so ∫_{B_R(0)} |h| ≤ C (le_of_tendsto'). ∎

  intro n R δ C h hδ hh htest
  set B : Set (Euclid n) := ball 0 (R + δ) with hB
  set hm : Euclid n → ℝ := hh.aestronglyMeasurable.mk h with hhm
  have hhm_meas : Measurable hm := hh.aestronglyMeasurable.stronglyMeasurable_mk.measurable
  have hae : h =ᵐ[volume.restrict B] hm := hh.aestronglyMeasurable.ae_eq_mk
  set g₀ : Euclid n → ℝ := (ball (0 : Euclid n) R).indicator (fun x => if 0 ≤ hm x then 1 else -1) with hg₀
  have hg₀m : Measurable g₀ :=

      measurableSet_ball
  have hg₀b : ∀ x, |g₀ x| ≤ 1 := by
    intro x; simp only [hg₀, Set.indicator]; split_ifs <;> norm_num
  have hg₀z : ∀ x, R ≤ ‖x‖ → g₀ x = 0 := by
    intro x hx
    simp only [hg₀]
    exact Set.indicator_of_notMem (by simpa [mem_ball_zero_iff] using hx) _
  obtain ⟨G, hGs, hGc, hGt, hGb, hGl⟩ :=
    Submission.cbr_ci_pw_bv_smooth_ae_approx n R δ g₀ hδ hg₀m hg₀b hg₀z
  have hle : ∀ j, ∫ x in B, h x * G j x ≤ C := by
    intro j
    rw [setIntegral_eq_integral_of_forall_compl_eq_zero (fun x hx => by
      rw [image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport (fun hx' => hx (hGt j hx')), mul_zero])]
    exact htest (G j) (hGs j) (hGc j) (hGt j) (hGb j)
  have hlim : Tendsto (fun j => ∫ x in B, h x * G j x) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x in B, h x * g₀ x)) := by
    refine tendsto_integral_of_dominated_convergence (fun x => ‖h x‖) (fun j => ?_) hh.norm (fun j => ?_) ?_
    · exact hh.aestronglyMeasurable.mul (hGs j).continuous.aestronglyMeasurable
    · refine Eventually.of_forall fun x => ?_
      rw [norm_mul]
      exact mul_le_of_le_one_right (norm_nonneg _) (by rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact hGb j x)
    · exact (ae_restrict_of_ae hGl).mono fun x hx => tendsto_const_nhds.mul hx
  have heq : ∫ x in B, h x * g₀ x = ∫ x in ball 0 R, |h x| := by
    have h1 : (fun x => h x * g₀ x) =ᵐ[volume.restrict B] (ball (0 : Euclid n) R).indicator (fun x => |h x|) := by
      filter_upwards [hae] with x hx
      simp only [hg₀, Set.indicator]

    rw [integral_congr_ae h1, setIntegral_indicator measurableSet_ball,
